notablePrerequisites:
Empowered Autogenerator does not have summoning sickness.
Empowered Autogenerator has at least two charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Sydri by paying {U}, causing Empowered Autogenerator to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying {1}{U}{U}, enchanting Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by putting a charge counter and tapping it, adding {U} equal to charge counters on Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat from step 2.
